nav_logo.title: SampleHelp logo
nav_logo.desc: Click to return to the main feed of questions.

nav_feed.title: Feed
nav_feed.desc: Main screen: fresh community questions. Listen to previews, expand answers right in the feed, or open a question page.

nav_favorites.title: Favorites
nav_favorites.desc: Questions you starred ⭐. They stay here even after being closed as solved.

nav_messages.title: Messages
nav_messages.desc: Private chats with members. The red badge counts unread messages.

nav_bell.title: Notifications
nav_bell.desc: Answers to your questions, likes, accepted solutions, thanks and reminders. Click opens the panel; click an item to jump to the question.

nav_help.title: "What's this?" help
nav_help.desc: Turns on help mode: the site's functionality is temporarily blocked and clicking any element shows what it does. Esc or another click exits. Also: a quick tour and the /help page.

nav_ask.title: Ask a question
nav_ask.desc: Opens the new question form: title, description, audio example (file or mic/screen recording), synth and category.

nav_usermenu.title: Profile menu
nav_usermenu.desc: Your avatar: profile, help, moderation (admins), support the project and log out.

auth_login.title: Log in
auth_login.desc: Sign in for registered members. In demo mode any e-mail and a 6+ character password works.

auth_signup.title: Sign up
auth_signup.desc: Create an account: e-mail, name and password. A short onboarding about your DAWs and synths follows.

footer_support.title: Support the project
footer_support.desc: Opens SampleHelp support options. Money goes directly to the recipient — the platform never touches it.

footer_demo.title: Mode indicator
footer_demo.desc: Shows whether the site runs on demo data or a live Supabase backend.

feed_sort.title: Feed sorting
feed_sort.desc: New — by date; Popular — by likes and answers; Unanswered — questions nobody has helped with yet.

feed_card.title: Question card
feed_card.desc: Click the card to expand answers and comments right in the feed. Click the title for the full question page with all tools.

feed_minplayer.title: Mini player
feed_minplayer.desc: Waveform of the audio example: click to play/pause the preview. Marker chips below play from a specific moment.

feed_answer_btn.title: "Answer" button
feed_answer_btn.desc: Opens the question page and the answer form. Answering is closed on solved questions.

fav_btn.title: Favorite ⭐
fav_btn.desc: Saves the question to Favorites (star icon in the header). Click again to remove. Read-only for solved questions.

status_badge.title: Question status
status_badge.desc: "Open" — awaiting answers. "✓ Solved" — the author accepted a solution; after 7 days the question is archived and the page becomes a stub.

presence_widget.title: Who's online
presence_widget.desc: How many members and guests are on the site right now. Click for the list with profile links. You can hide yourself in profile settings.

ad_slot.title: Ad slot
ad_slot.desc: Ads (Yandex network) may appear here — they pay for the project's servers. Currently disabled by configuration.

like_btn.title: Like 🔥
like_btn.desc: Boost the question in the Popular feed. One like per member per question.

share_btn.title: Share 🔗
share_btn.desc: Copies the question link to the clipboard — handy for messengers.

report_btn.title: Report ⚑
report_btn.desc: Send a report to moderators: spam, insults, stolen content. Duplicate reports on the same item are rejected.

follow_btn.title: Follow author
follow_btn.desc: "+ Follow" — get notified about this author's new questions. Click again to unfollow.

edit_btn.title: Edit ✏️
edit_btn.desc: Modify your own content. Visible to the author only; edits are marked.

delete_btn.title: Delete 🗑
delete_btn.desc: Permanently delete your own content. Author only, asks for confirmation.

player_play.title: Play button ▶
player_play.desc: Play/pause the audio example from the current position.

player_wave.title: Waveform
player_wave.desc: Loudness graph of the example: click seeks to that point, the copper bar shows progress. Dots on the wave are the author's markers.

player_markers.title: Markers
player_markers.desc: Chips like "0:12 — that growl": click plays from that moment, click again pauses. The author marks the most interesting bits.

ab_btn.title: A/B compare 🎧
ab_btn.desc: Blind comparison: A is the question audio, B is the answer audio. Click a side (or press A/B, Space) to play it from the start — hear how close the answer is.

answer_card.title: Answer card
answer_card.desc: Answer text, type (technique/preset/tutorial), difficulty, tags, plus audio example and preset if attached. The accepted solution gets a copper frame.

answer_like.title: Like answer 🔥
answer_like.desc: Show the answer is helpful. Likes raise it in the list and grow the author's reputation.

solution_btn.title: Mark as solution ✓
solution_btn.desc: Question author's button: this answer solved it. The question closes and archives in 7 days; the answer's author gains reputation and an achievement.

thanks_btn.title: Say thanks ☕
thanks_btn.desc: Send the answer's author words of gratitude (and support if they added payment options). The ☕ counter is a badge of appreciation.

comment_form.title: Comments
comment_form.desc: Short follow-ups under an answer: ask a detail or say thanks. Enter sends the comment.

q_stats.title: Question stats
q_stats.desc: Answers, likes, status and how many people are viewing the page right now.

answer_form.title: Answer form
answer_form.desc: Describe the technique (oscillators, modulation, effects), pick type and difficulty, add tags, an audio example, a preset and links.

attach_audio_btn.title: Attach audio 📁
attach_audio_btn.desc: Pick an audio file from your computer. Long recordings can be trimmed; audio is loudness-normalized.

rec_btn.title: Record from mic ⏺
rec_btn.desc: Record an example with your microphone (up to 60 s). The question form also supports screen audio capture.

rec_allow.title: Allow microphone
rec_allow.desc: The browser will ask for mic access. Without permission recording can't start — check the site's browser settings.

rec_start.title: Start/stop recording
rec_start.desc: ⏺ starts (timer and level meter run), ⏹ stops and attaches the result to the message or answer.

preset_upload.title: Synth preset
preset_upload.desc: Attach a preset file (.fxb/.fxp/.json) — others can download it and hear your sound instantly.

links_editor.title: Links
links_editor.desc: Tutorials, articles, videos and presets on topic. Links pasted into the text become preview cards.

marker_picker.title: Answer markers
marker_picker.desc: Place up to 8 marks on your audio: "that growl", "the drop". Click 📍 to add a marker at the playhead.

purge_banner.title: Archive timer
purge_banner.desc: A solved question lives 7 more days, then its content is deleted and the page becomes a stub — links stop leading nowhere.

unresolve_btn.title: Unmark solution ↩
unresolve_btn.desc: Return the question to Open (author only): answers reopen and archiving is cancelled.

ask_title.title: Question title
ask_title.desc: Short and to the point: "Harsh growl bass like in X". Up to 120 characters — it's how others find your question.

ask_desc.title: Description
ask_desc.desc: What the sound is, where you heard it, what you already tried. More context — better answers.

ask_synth.title: Synthesizer
ask_synth.desc: Which synth you want to recreate the sound in (Serum, Phase Plant, Vital…). Add your own via "+".

ask_category.title: Category
ask_category.desc: Sound type: bass, lead, pad, FX, drums… Helps filtering the feed and finding category experts.

ask_submit.title: Publish question
ask_submit.desc: Validates required fields and posts the question to the feed. The form draft saves automatically.

trimmer.title: Audio trimmer
trimmer.desc: Cut the excess: drag the copper selection edges or use Start/End sliders; wheel scrolls, Ctrl+wheel zooms. Markers and length (up to 20 s) are saved with the question.

profile_settings_btn.title: Profile settings ⚙️
profile_settings_btn.desc: Name, bio, interface language, cover, DAWs/arsenal, skills, links, collab openness, online visibility and support options.

support_user_btn.title: Support member ☕
support_user_btn.desc: Open this member's support options (if they added any) and send words of gratitude.

message_btn.title: Send message 💬
message_btn.desc: Open a private chat with this member. You can attach audio in chats.

avatar_btn.title: Change avatar 📷
avatar_btn.desc: Upload an image and crop it with the round cropper.

best_answers.title: Best answers
best_answers.desc: Auto-showcase: the user's answers that question authors marked as solutions. It builds itself — nothing to set up.

profile_tabs.title: Profile tabs
profile_tabs.desc: Questions, answers and (on your own profile) favorites.

profile_links.title: Profile links
profile_links.desc: Socials, channels, portfolio. Paste a URL — the type is detected automatically (icon and color).

profile_stats.title: Stats
profile_stats.desc: Questions, answers, reputation and rating. Reputation grows from likes and accepted solutions.

set_lang.title: Interface language
set_lang.desc: Russian, English or German. Applies to the whole site instantly.

set_username.title: Username
set_username.desc: How other members see you. Up to 24 characters.

set_bio.title: About you
set_bio.desc: A couple of lines: genres, experience, how you can help. Shown on your profile.

set_cover.title: Profile cover
set_cover.desc: Decorative waveform behind the avatar — pick a style and color from presets.

set_links.title: Links
set_links.desc: Add/remove socials and portfolio — see "Profile links".

set_daw.title: My DAWs
set_daw.desc: Mark the software you work in (Ableton, FL Studio…). Shows an "answers from their DAW" badge on your answers.

set_arsenal.title: Arsenal
set_arsenal.desc: Your synths and plugins — helps others see how close you are to the question's topic.

set_collab.title: Open to collabs
set_collab.desc: Shows an "open to collabs" badge on your profile so like-minded people can find you.

set_hide_online.title: Hide my online status
set_hide_online.desc: You won't appear in "Who's online" (neither in the list nor the member count).

set_skills.title: Skills
set_skills.desc: Skill tags via Enter: sound design, mixing, Serum… Shown on your profile.

set_donate.title: Support options ☕
set_donate.desc: Add where people can send you support: card/phone transfer, crypto, Boosty etc. Money goes directly to you — the platform never sees it. A ☕ button appears on your profile and under your answers.

set_done.title: Done
set_done.desc: Close settings. All changes are saved automatically as you type.

msg_conv.title: Conversations
msg_conv.desc: Your private chats: last snippet, time and unread counter.

msg_input.title: Message field
msg_input.desc: Text of the private message. SampleHelp question links turn into preview cards.

msg_send.title: Send ➤
msg_send.desc: Send the message. Enter does the same.

msg_react.title: Reactions 😀
msg_react.desc: Quick emoji response without extra words. Click your own reaction again to remove it.

msg_actions.title: Message actions
msg_actions.desc: Appear on hover: react, and for your own messages — edit ✏️ and delete 🗑.

notif_item.title: Notification
notif_item.desc: Click to jump to the related question: answer, like, solution, thanks or reminder.

notif_mark_all.title: Mark all read
notif_mark_all.desc: Clear the unread counter in one click.

mod_dismiss.title: Dismiss report
mod_dismiss.desc: The report is unfounded — close it without touching the content.

mod_remove.title: Remove content
mod_remove.desc: Take the content down per the report (admins). The author gets notified.

report_modal.title: Report form
report_modal.desc: Pick a reason (spam, insults, stolen content), optionally add a note — moderators will review it.

sup_methods.title: Support options
sup_methods.desc: Recipient details: "Go" opens the service (bank/crypto/Boosty…), "Copy" copies the number. The platform doesn't process payments — transfers are direct.

sup_thanks.title: Words of gratitude
sup_thanks.desc: A short note to the recipient (up to 140 characters). Sent along with the "thanks" and raises their ☕ counter.

sup_disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
sup_disclaimer.desc: SampleHelp is not involved in the transfer: you support the member or project directly and are responsible for the amount and details yourself.

helpPage.subtitle: How SampleHelp works — short and to the point.
helpPage.cta_text: The best way to learn is to poke around: enable the "What's this?" mode and click the interface (nothing will break), or take the 8-step tour.

what_is.d: A Q&A community of sound designers: upload an audio example of the sound you want to recreate — members suggest techniques, presets or tutorials for Serum, Phase Plant, Vital and other synths.

ask.d: Press "+ Ask a question": title, description, synth and category, plus an audio example — file, microphone or screen-audio recording. Trim the excess in the trimmer and mark key moments with markers.

answer.d: On the question page: text with the technique (oscillators, modulation, effects), type and difficulty, tags, your own audio example with markers and a preset file. The question author marks the best solution ✓ — it lands in your "Best answers" showcase.

audio.d: Clicking the waveform seeks; marker chips play from the marked moment. The 🎧 A/B button on an answer starts a blind comparison with the original: A is the question, B is the answer; keys A/B and Space switch sides.

profile.d: Your profile holds the cover, DAWs and arsenal, skills, links, online visibility and an auto-showcase of your best answers. All settings save automatically.

donate.d: Members can add their own support options (bank transfer, crypto, Boosty…) and you can send them gratitude. Money goes directly to the recipient — the platform never touches it. The footer's "Support the project" does the same for SampleHelp.

social.d: The bell — answers, likes, solutions and reminders; the envelope — private chats with audio attachments and reactions; the "Who's online" chip — who's on the site right now (hide yourself in settings).

moderation.d: The ⚑ flag on any question, answer or comment sends a report to moderators: spam, insults, stolen content. Solved questions live 7 days then archive, so links never lead nowhere.
